name_reason: Conforms to global naming convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: data_fd2_ game-global prefix, battle domain (matches sibling cinematic-bg globals at 0x54103 / 0x5410B which all use data_fd2_battle_), descriptor combat_cinematic_spotlight_bg_buf_ptr accurately reflects the spotlight terrain-backdrop BG.DAT buffer and the _ptr data type (32-bit heap pointer). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Accurately reflects use verified against decompilation of all 3 accessor functions.
purpose: Heap pointer to the terrain-backdrop (spotlight background) BG.DAT RLE buffer used by the combat/character full-screen cinematics.
logic_summary: Zero-init .bss 32-bit pointer. fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation (@0x28784) and fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic (@0x28A6C) each NULL it, then assign the malloc-backed result of fd2_load_dat_resource(BG.DAT, ..., terrain_idx), RLE-blit it as the spotlight background, and free() it on cleanup. fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic additionally swaps it with the B split background data_fd2_battle_combat_cinematic_split_bg_b_buf_ptr (0x54103) in the split-screen path when the attacker is enemy-team (p_attacker->team == 0). fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic (@0x2939D) reads it (PUSH dword [0x54107]) and passes it as the last arg of the charge-in bg zoom transitions fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_out (@0x29C90) and ..._in (@0x29DED).
datatype: undefined4 (32-bit heap pointer; declared uint32 in src, holds malloc'd BG.DAT RLE buffer or NULL)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer: address of the malloc-backed terrain-backdrop BG.DAT RLE sprite buffer for the active cinematic, or NULL when idle / before load / after free.
notes: Verified all 14 xrefs (WRITEs at 0x28795/0x2889c/0x28aa5/0x28cd4/0x28e10, READs in both cinematic players + fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic). Game write-xrefs present -> non-const mutable runtime pointer (src uint32 correct). Source comment (anicine.c lines 49-62) already accurate, precise, ASCII-only, convention-compliant; no edit needed (comment kept). Ghidra plate semantically consistent with src -> plate untouched. In the split-screen charge-in path the zoom transitions instead receive 0x54103 (split_bg_b); the non-split path passes this spotlight buffer -- comment wording 'passed to the bg zoom transitions' is accurate for the spotlight path. No logic concerns.
